row.title: A study's summary must not address the reader with an instruction, because the docs audit reads the generated paper
row.body: The Conant and Ashby study summary said 'you must model it'. The generated paper carried the line, docs_audit --check read it as telling a person to act, and main went red for every pull request. The summary now states the same idea without addressing a reader. Study text is generated into papers and read by the same audit as any document.

title: A study's summary must not address the reader with an instruction, because the docs audit reads the generated paper
